3.3.2 Primitive Types
Franca IDL has a set of predefined, so called primitive, data types: integers, floats, Boolean values, and strings. Whereas integers, floats, and booleans are covered by the AUTOSAR platform types, strings have to be encoded. In the following we define the application and implementation data types that are generated by the Franca-to-AUTOSAR translation to represent the primitive types of Franca IDL. Both application and implementation types obtain the short names given in table 3.10. Integration of Franca IDL Software Component Descriptions
